title: Secure Digital Future in the Age of Quantum Computers
summary: Document from Slovenia's Government Information Security Office (URSIV) warning that post-quantum cryptography (PQC) is becoming a necessary part of ensuring cybersecurity, as today's cryptographic solutions will not suffice against quantum computers.

title: The European Union's Roadmap for Post-Quantum Cryptography (FAQ)
summary: FAQ recommendation document published by Slovenia's Government Information Security Office (URSIV) explaining the EU roadmap for post-quantum cryptography (PQC) and related terminology such as PQC and NIS.

title: WB3C Training for Information Security Leaders in Critical Infrastructure and Public Administration
summary: Slovenian government news item on a WB3C training for information security leaders in critical infrastructure and public administration, covering post-quantum cryptography and NIS2 directive obligations.

title: Strategija razvoja kvantnih tehnologij v Sloveniji do leta 2035 (Strategy for the Development of Quantum Technologies in Slovenia until 2035)
summary: National quantum-technologies strategy published by Slovenia's Ministry of Higher Education, Science and Innovation (MVZI), addressing quantum communication, QKD/QRNG and research into the quantum security of elliptic-curve cryptography. An explicit post-quantum/quantum-safe cryptography (PQC) migration reference could not be verified because the PDF text was not machine-extractable; flagged as a draft for human review.

title: Politika o varnosti omrežnih in informacijskih sistemov: vzorčna dokumentacija
summary: Model network and information security policy (version 1.0, November 2025) published by the Government Information Security Office (URSIV) as a sample template to help mainly small and medium organisations comply with the Information Security Act (ZInfV-1). Its confidentiality principles call for strong encryption with a gradual transition to post-quantum algorithms, and its cryptography policy requires considering quantum-attack resistance (PQC) when choosing algorithms and checking that new ICT purchases support post-quantum algorithms.

title: Načrt varnostnih ukrepov za zagotavljanje zaupnosti, celovitosti, razpoložljivosti in avtentičnosti omrežnih in informacijskih sistemov: vzorčna dokumentacija
summary: Model security measures plan (version 1.0, November 2025) from the Government Information Security Office, written as sample documentation for organisations subject to ZInfV-1. Its cryptography measures require considering resistance to quantum attacks (PQC) when choosing algorithms, checking vendor support for post-quantum algorithms in new ICT purchases, and reviewing algorithms at least every 12 months against ENISA and NIST recommendations.

title: Kriptografija onkraj obzorja včeraj in kriptografija jutri. Kvantni kažipot.
summary: News item of 10 December 2024 from the Government Office for the Protection of Classified Information about a workshop it held on 22 November 2024 on quantum technologies and cryptography. It explains that quantum computing calls for new protections, naming post-quantum cryptography and quantum key distribution.
